title: Earth Observing 1 (EO-1)
lineage: Publisher or operator text. Local file preserves selected passages and research notes.

passages.note: The original one-year validation mission was completed in November 2001 and an extended mission collected further ALI and Hyperion observations. USGS notices in 2017 describe the end of normal imaging and continued access to historical observations. Dates attached to imaging, decommissioning and spacecraft shutdown refer to different milestones or announced dates.

file.method: Selected, claim-specific paraphrases and short excerpts from the cited passages.
